week.name: Friday
week.short: Mostly Cloudy then Chance Light Rain
week.detailed: A chance of rain after 5pm. Mostly cloudy. High near 60, with temperatures falling to around 56 in the afternoon. South southeast wind 2 to 8 mph. Chance of precipitation is 30%.

week.name: Saturday
week.detailed: Rain before 5pm. Cloudy, with a high near 47. Southwest wind around 2 mph. Chance of precipitation is 90%.

week.name: Sunday
week.detailed: Mostly sunny, with a high near 52.
